page.overview:
What is Four Emperors?

Four Emperors may refer to:

The Order of the Four Emperors The Roman Emperors Galba, Otho, Vitellius, and Vespasian, who successively came to power in AD 68 and 69, the Year of the Four Emperors The Shiseiten, from the manga Samurai Deeper Kyo The Yonkou (literally Four Emperors), four pirates in the anime/manga series One Piece
